This plot is rented, so I must make sure the yield is good enough to cover the rent and still feed my family. I will apply a small amount of NPK fertilizer and also spread poultry manure, because the soil on this leased land is not very strong. My wife and children will work most days on weeding and staking, but I will hire laborers for the heavy land clearing and harvesting periods. I will plant with my own cassava stems since improved stems are costly and hard to find here, and I will not irrigate because the rains in the South East are usually enough.
